items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I can't remember who played. O'Brien is the only one I can remember in the band. So it might have been Blythe... Yeah. It might have been the pianist. Yeah. It might have been Blythe.

ctx.x: That's what they say, good singer. Yeah. He made a record once with Tommy Ladner and Jimmy Noon and all that.

Oh yes, yes, yes. I have that. Yeah, I worked with Jimmy too, worked with Jimmy Noon, well I used to play at dances. After all. Then I used to, I worked with, uh, Charlie Cook, that was over to Dreamland, over. Oh, the Harman's Westside. Yeah, Westside, uh huh.
The Johnny St. Cyr, I think Noon were over there too. That's right, yeah, that's right, that's right.
